identity.name: The Lucky Knot Wedding Chapel
identity.description: A 24-hour Las Vegas wedding chapel — plastic flowers, a heart-shaped neon arch buzzing on the wall, rows of cheap pews. Outside the stained-glass windows the sky is the wrong color. Something is pounding on the double doors.

connections.label: Out through the shattered doors to the Strip

ambient: The neon heart arch buzzes, dims, and catches again.
Something scrabbles across the roof and is gone.

art.prompt: A tacky neon Las Vegas wedding chapel interior at night during an apocalypse, heart-shaped neon arch, overturned pews, red sky through stained glass, B-movie horror, oil painting style

identity.name: The Apocalypse Kid
identity.description: Leather jacket, katana across the back, a wedding you were definitely not invited to. You don't know why the world is ending, but you intend to outlive it.

list.name: Guardian Ghost
list.special: Summon a spectral ally that fights for 3 turns.

list.name: Apocalypse Now
list.special: Overdrive finisher — rip the whole zone apart. Requires a full meter.

identity.name: Katana
identity.description: A folded-steel katana, scratched but razor-keen. Your one good decision this week.

identity.name: Padre Salt
identity.description: The chapel's Elvis-impersonator officiant, sequined jumpsuit half-burned, a pump shotgun where a hymnal should be. He is not, it turns out, an actual priest.

persona.personality: Loud, fast-talking, weirdly calm about the end of the world. Treats the apocalypse like a bad Tuesday shift.
persona.backstory: Twenty years marrying drunk strangers in this chapel. When the sky cracked he reached under the lectern for the shotgun he keeps for robberies.
persona.voice: Vegas lounge drawl, peppers speech with 'baby' and 'thankyaverymuch'. Gallows humor.

facts: The things at the door are imps — small, mean, and they travel in packs.
There's a Cadillac idling out front with the keys still in it; the groom ran off without it.
The whole Strip is on fire. Heading north toward Fremont is suicide; the car is the only way out.
secrets: He saw an angel with rainbow wings pull two people into the sky an hour ago and has decided not to mention it in case it sounds crazy.
He's out of shotgun shells after the next two blasts.

list.name: Shotgun Blast
list.special: A pump-shotgun roar — two shells, then he's dry.

identity.name: Snarling Imp
identity.description: A knee-high devil the color of a bruise, all teeth and claws, dripping something black onto the carpet.

persona.personality: Vicious, gleeful, dumb. Attacks the nearest warm thing.
persona.voice: High, scratchy, gleeful — taunts in broken English.

facts: We came through the rift to kill everything warm.
secrets: We fear the big one that comes after us far more than we fear you.

identity.name: The Las Vegas Strip
identity.description: The Strip in full apocalypse: a casino marquee shears off and crashes into the street, fire-hydrant geysers turn pink in the neon, and figures that are not people lope between the stalled cars. A cherry-red Cadillac idles at the curb, driver's door open, keys swinging in the ignition.

ambient: A slot machine inside a dead casino pays out to nobody.
Ash sifts down like snow onto the Cadillac's hood.

identity.name: Idling Cadillac
identity.description: A cherry-red convertible Cadillac, engine running, keys in the ignition, the groom nowhere in sight. Your ride out of this dying city — if you can reach it and floor it.

identity.name: Get Out of Vegas
identity.description: Survive the imps, reach the Strip, and steal the idling Cadillac to flee Las Vegas — the first leg of a much longer road through the Apocalypse.

steps: Survive the imps swarming the chapel.
Take the idling Cadillac and floor it out of the city.
